Russia, Ukraine exchange drone and missile attacks; casualties reported

Russia launched a barrage of ballistic missiles and drones on Ukraine's capital region, killing at least 14 people and injuring 22, according to Ukrainian authorities. In response, Ukraine conducted drone attacks across Russia. One Ukrainian drone strike hit a Wildberries warehouse in the Vladimir region, causing a large fire and killing at least six people, according to local officials. Another Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian beach resort killed seven, including three children, Russia stated. Ukrainian police released footage showing a drone pursuing an unidentified man in Ukraine.
